notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Emry.
Emry does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sol Ring, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sol Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
